title: Fall Festival
seo_title: Fall Festival at Berean Baptist Church in Bolivar, MO
description: Berean Baptist Church's first Fall Festival is an afternoon of family fun with cornhole tournaments, a bounce house, face and pumpkin painting, crafts, flag football, yard games, a cake walk, a bonfire, hayrides, s'mores and hotdogs. It is for the whole family; bring a lawn chair and a pumpkin to decorate (no carving required), and cake walk tickets are by donation toward the church's new building fund. It takes place November 14, 2026 (Time TBD) at 4450 Scenic Ave in Bolivar, MO.
